parsed.note: The proposed changes (reverting batch size to 262144 and probing MATRIX_LR 0.10) are ordinary hyperparameter tuning within the fixed budget, and the reminder to keep shard 10 out of TRAIN_SHARDS actively protects the fixed eval from leakage rather than gaming it.
